item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":35,"statement":"After one call through the parent module and then one direct call to the `ChainOfThought` submodule, the program shows `parent.history` has length 1 while both the submodule history and its underlying predictor history have length 2.","span_ids":["s1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"The history item created by the parent-triggered LM call is the same shared object in ancestor and child module histories, which can be proven with object identity rather than just equal contents.","span_ids":["s2","s4"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"With `disable_history=True`, a subsequent LM call does not append any new history entry anywhere, so the parent, submodule, and predictor history lengths all remain unchanged.","span_ids":["s3","s5"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"A correct runnable example configures DSPy with a `DummyLM` and `JSONAdapter`, defines a parent `dspy.Module` whose `forward` delegates to a `ChainOfThought` child, and invokes both the parent and the child directly to exercise the history behavior.","span_ids":["s1"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"tests/primitives/test_base_module.py","start_line":391,"end_line":417},{"span_id":"s2","path":"tests/primitives/test_base_module.py","start_line":419,"end_line":420},{"span_id":"s3","path":"tests/primitives/test_base_module.py","start_line":424,"end_line":430},{"span_id":"s4","path":"dspy/clients/base_lm.py","start_line":241,"end_line":246},{"span_id":"s5","path":"dspy/clients/base_lm.py","start_line":98,"end_line":100}]}
